handoff_changes.section: H2 argument defaults, refined by H15
handoff_changes.change: Every delta addition and amendment must carry its full nonempty argument schema. The builder no longer supplies empty arguments or a token for an omitted commit schema. It still defaults an added slot_map to preserve. The historical H2 fixture is adapted only in memory.
handoff_changes.why: RA1-09 requires explicit pinned inputs in the real delta. The older fixture is outside this packet and predates H15.

vector.given: Remove arguments from the jumble.on addition, or from the macro.add amendment set, in memory.
vector.expected: TableError before any output: missing required H2 fields for the addition, or an explicit argument schema required for the amendment.

rebind_undo_row.given: Action 41 recorded grip.rebind from map A to B; current ActionHint has order=42,target=41. Inspect session.undo in the final table and its join/aliases.
rebind_undo_row.expected: Only session.undo/session.redo are undo entries. Both use commit, by_target and action_hint; dispatch classes are journal and workspace. The specified workspace inverse restores A, returns committed, keeps puzzle head/hash and advances workspace versions; table tests do not execute that inverse.

conflicting_preview_row.given: An otherwise admissible complete word violates active protection. Inspect the final preview row and its delta amendment, then the execute row.
conflicting_preview_row.expected: operation.preview has no protection gate and can report the conflict in its completed preview; operation.execute retains protection and refuses that commit. Adding the protection gate back to the preview row or delta fails TableError.

hint_row_arguments.given: Action 41 is undoable and action 42 advanced durable order without becoming the inverse target. Bind hint order=42,target=41 and a fresh token.
hint_row_arguments.expected: Both undo rows require exactly hint:ActionHint and token:UserActionToken and action_guard=action_hint. Both numbers enter the binding. After action 43 lands the contract returns KN5:stale.undo_superseded; a scalar action schema fails the builder.

distinct_bindings.given: Build the real delta. Compare jumble.straddlers arguments snapshot=S7,cap=0,max_chunk=32 with snapshot=S7,cap=1,max_chunk=32; remove an argument schema in a separate negative copy.
distinct_bindings.expected: The schema contains snapshot:StateRef,cap:CapId,max_chunk:PositiveNat. The two argument and request bindings have different digests. All 16 additions and six amendments retain explicit schemas; operation.check includes snapshot, unit, cap, fields and max_chunk. An omitted or empty schema fails before output.

filter_gate_row.given: Apply a current FilterPreviewRef with no pending word preview, then change one of its filter dependencies. Separately mutate filter.apply back to the word gate in memory.
filter_gate_row.expected: filter.apply alone uses preview=filter and fresh_filter_preview, with no fresh_preview gate. The first contract input is fresh; the changed one returns KN5:stale.filter_preview. The old word-gate row, either gate/preview mismatch or a filter gate on macro.add fails the builder.

lane_target_rows.given: Inspect all view/latest_wins rows. Camera rotate and zoom name session S,view V; a third camera request names view W. Remove the release check target or name a missing argument in a copied row.
lane_target_rows.expected: Every such row has one nonempty arg/view/control target. Rotate and zoom resolve the same (S,V), so newer admitted work supersedes unfinished work there; (S,W) is independent. Phase selection, scrub and toggles have fixed command-ID control targets. Missing or malformed targets fail the builder.

layer_call_wording.given: The shell submits operation.execute to the command layer, which calls the engine and its coordinated store transaction.
layer_call_wording.expected: H-08 cites LI.3/LI.4 ownership and this shell-to-command-to-engine path; it contains no neighbour-only call restriction. Results reach the view model and renderer adapter.

final_build.given: Build in memory from the authored base, signed join, versioned aliases and real jumbling delta; compare encoded bytes with command-table.json.
final_build.expected: The bytes match exactly with LF and final=true: 168 commands (152 base plus 16 additions, six amendments) and nine separate services. The Markdown row list and kind counts match; the historical fixture contributes no row.

scrub_row.given: Inspect a solver-word jumbling preview P7 at literal prefix 10 under revision R7 through view.preview.scrub; compare the final row IDs and repeat allowlist.
scrub_row.expected: Only view.preview.scrub exists, with preview:PreviewId,prefix:WordPosition,revision:RevisionRef, job=true and repeat=true in its view lane. It shares the retained preview purpose and never exposes hidden scramble prefixes. The repeat allowlist remains exactly camera.rotate,camera.zoom,list.move,view.preview.scrub; a duplicate jumbling scrub row fails.

services_list.given: Resolve all ten annex requires entries against the final table; in negative copies remove kernel.snapshot.open, remove jumble.observe, or use one service ID as a command.
services_list.expected: Nine IDs resolve in services (kernel.stream.next is a continuation); jumble.observe resolves in commands. Services have only id,kind,caller,lane,clauses,note and no command affordances. Each missing or colliding registration fails; requires cannot authorize its own missing ID.
